figurative_meaning_en: To pass time by gossiping or engaging in idle chatter
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সারাদিন বন্ধুদের সাথে টপ্পা মারে।
অফিসে বসে টপ্পা মেরে সময় নষ্ট করো না।
example_sentences_in_english: She spends the whole day shooting the breeze with friends.
Don't waste time chewing the fat at the office.
note: This idiom reflects everyday colloquial Bengali usage, often implying light-hearted but unproductive social interaction.
